CITY OF CARSON  THURSDAY, JANUARY 21, 2021
HOUSING AUTHORITY/  701 East Carson Street
SUCCESSOR AGENCY/  Helen Kawagoe Council Chambers
CITY COUNCIL AGENDA  6:00 PM

  Lula Davis-Holmes, Mayor
Jim Dear, Mayor Pro Tem  Jawane Hilton, Councilmember
Cedric L. Hicks, Councilmember

Donesia L. Gause, City Clerk  Monica Cooper, City Treasurer

  SPECIAL MEETING OF
  CARSON CITY COUNCIL AND CARSON HOUSING AUTHORITY

**ORAL COMMUNICATIONS**
The public may address the members of the City Council on any matters within the
jurisdiction of the City Council or on any items on the agenda of the City Council ,
other than closed session matters, prior to any action taken on the agenda.
Because of the threat of COVID-19 (aka the “Coronavirus”) you are urged to take
all appropriate health safety precautions.

DUE TO CORONAVIRUS COVID-19, NO MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC WILL BE
ALLOWED INTO THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS DURING CARSON COUNCIL
MEETINGS.

TO FACILITATE PUBLIC PARTICIPATION  OUR  CARSON  CITY  COUNCIL
MEETINGS WILL BE AVAILABLE TO YOU BY:

• Livestream on the City’s website:  The meeting will be conducted live over the
internet via http://ci.carson.ca.us

•  Cable Channel 35 (Spectrum) and Channel 99 (AT&T)

Any members of the public wishing to provide public comment for the items on the
agenda may do so as follows:
1. Email:  You can email comments to cityclerk@carson.ca.us  or through the
home page of our city’s website at ci.carson.ca.us, up until the meeting’s
published start time. Please identify the Agenda item you wish to address in your
comments. Your comments will be read into the record.

2. Telephone: You can record your comments at (310) 952-1720, up until the

the meeting’s published start time. Please identify the Agenda item you wish to
address in your comments. Your comments will be read into the record.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS (COUNCIL MEMBERS) CH implored upon residents to remain safe and exercise all safety precautions. 

JH gave information about vaccinations for persons 65 years or older. 

JD inquired about progress on using the Dignity Center Health Park becoming a vaccination center.  Staff addressed his inquiry.

ADJOURNMENT

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR MATTERS LISTED ON THE AGENDA (MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC)

1.. CONSIDER APPROVING THE RESUMPTION OF THE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION TO VIRTUAL REGULAR MONTHLY MEETINGS TO ADVISE THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT ON ESSENTIAL INITIATIVES  (CITY COUNCIL)

CONSENT: (Item 1)  -  Action: adopted (Pass) Moved by Jim Dear

3.. GENERAL PLAN UPDATE AND PRESENTATION OF THE PREFERRED  PLAN  (CITY COUNCIL) Director Naaseh gave a PowerPoint presentation on the General Plan update. 

Mayor and City Council asked questions, Staff addressed them. 

City Council directed staff to bring back a survey of other cities addressing a requirement for a 15 - 25% margin of affordable housing for all future residential development.

LDH noted that she would like staff to plan a tour around the city to see the areas addressed in the General Plan. 
 
Recessed at 7:39pm, reconvened at 7:43pm 

Meeting went into Recess

Meeting Reconvened
